{{Quote|This is between us, and is long overdue. Do you agree?''"<br />"''I do.|Saes Rrogon and Relin Druur|<ref name="CC" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place over the [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]] of [[Phaegon III]] shortly before the outbreak of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]]'s former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Saes Rrogon]], had recently turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and Druur and his new Padawan, [[Drev Hassin]], hunted Rrogon down. They found that he had joined [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and after relaying this finding to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], decided to track Rrogon down and confront him. Rrogon, meanwhile, had been made [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] and, along with Captain [[Yaru Korsin]] in the ''[[Omen]]'', had been sent to locate and [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Lignan]], an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] which was extremely powerful in the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], for use during the impending [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They found that the largest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Phaegon III contained immense amounts of Lignan, and began mining the moon.

As the Sith finished mining the ore, Druur and Hassin arrived in-[[Star system/Legends|system]] and assaulted them. Druur infiltrated the ''Harbinger'' to damage its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] while Drev held off ten [[Blade-class starfighter|''Blade''-class starfighters]] which the Sith [[Starship/Legends|ships]] deployed against him in the Jedi's [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]]. Rrogon, however, found Druur, and engaged in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] against him. Rrogon [[Cho sun/Legends|cut off]] Druur's arm, but the duel was cut off when the explosives which Druur had put on the hyperdrive went off, incapacitating Rrogon. Drev, however, realized that the ''Harbinger'' was still attempting to deliver the Lignan to the Sith Empire, and, his [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] having already been hit several times, decided to ram the ''Harbinger''{{'s}} bridge. Druur attempted to flee in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], but the ''Harbinger'' meanwhile knocked into the ''Omen'' just as both ships entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ''Omen'' was knocked off-course to the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where its survivors eventually formed the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], while the ''Harbinger'' itself [[Time travel/Legends|traveled]] thorugh [[Time/Legends|time]] to [[41 ABY]].
